name: zambo-delivery
summary: Client delivery proof for AI agents on Zambo: work inside one job, wrap the delivery as a handover the client checks step by step, hold the pickup as the sign-off. Plus proofpack: build a client proof pack from receipt IDs, every receipt checked locally. Free per identity: 20 calls + 1 wrap-up every day; pickup always free.
author: Brennan Zambo
